shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement), fully simulated linked maps behaving as ONE BIG MAP: live plumb see-below view with in-place selection (single + double-click select-all-of-type) and item-count/quality overlays, biome-driven sky plateaus, full cross-level parity (work/haul/supply, trade beacons, mech recharge, gear probes, childcare), priority-aware work, bulk inventory hauling compat (PUAH/Hauler's Dream) + Allow Tool priority hauling across levels, probe-gated robot migration, Achtung drags, wide stairs, jobs-cadence settings, kill-switch panel, TRUE through-gap combat, pod transit + AA, elevators, opt-in threats, world integration, self-testing harness, modder API. Parity audit in docs/ is the living roadmap.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (x/z identity, altitude drop only), dim slider. Things shrink about own center (belowThingScale).
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule (bound anchor elsewhere invalidates ANY giver answer incl. cell targets).
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has (build/install/refuel).
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**: every order reads as base game — replace disabled vanilla row, inherit orderInPriority + target icon, Default priority.
- **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**: every arrival continuation self-heals.
- **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD**: while locked, ALL automatic level switches blocked at the Game.CurrentMap setter. Manual switches via JumpPreservingView set ManualSwitch to bypass. Column-scoped.
- **IsPlayerHome column identity** (ColumnAsHome): pocket levels report the ground map's home verdict (stands down inside AlertsReadout scope + QuestGen). Load-bearing for hauling-mod compat (Hauler's Dream gates on map.IsPlayerHome).
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).

## SEE-BELOW view — rendering + interaction (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer)
Plumb one-way mirror: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings reprints the lower map's map-mesh things into the sky map per open-air cell; live pawns via DrawPos altitude-shift (OffsetActive) + PawnDrawParms shrink. CellVisibleFromAbove = unroofed + open air on sky + unfogged.
- **Select in place** (selectBelowInPlace): left-click a below pawn/item/building (seen through open air) selects it WITHOUT switching maps/camera; Selector.SelectUnderMouse prefix. Brackets draw through the see-below transform.
- **NEW 2026-07-23 — double-click select-all-of-type**: prefix Selector.SelectAllMatchingObjectUnderMouseOnScreen; when a below thing is under the cursor (and no sky thing blocks), select every matching below thing on screen in place (vanilla validator: same def+faction, race-equivalence/mutant/host checks for pawns, skip neverMultiSelect). Uses CameraDriver.CurrentViewRect over the lower map. Safe against the double-click MouseUp sequence (vanilla only re-runs SelectUnderMouse when dragBox.active, which is false on the 2nd click).
- **NEW 2026-07-23 — item counts + overlays** (belowItemOverlays toggle, default on): postfix ThingOverlays.ThingOverlaysOnGUI runs the same HasGUIOverlay pass over the lower map's visible-from-above things and calls Thing.DrawGUIOverlay. Plumb means DrawPos projects to the correct screen cell with no transform; inherits vanilla's closest-zoom gate (counts appear zoomed in). New TryGetLiveBelowView gate needs only showLiveBelow. View tab gets the new checkbox; Keyed AB_BelowItemOverlays(+Tip).

## HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B: bulk spans levels, single-carry fallback) — 2026-07-23, PUAH + HD user-verified
- **ABInventoryHaulBridge** (reflection): PUAH (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul) + Hauler's Dream (giwaffed.HaulersDream) CompHauledToInventory.RegisterHauledItem + static PawnUnloadChecker. AnyActive/HasComp/Register/RequestUnload. Cached; broken-flag per system → fallback. No foreign types in signatures.
- **CrossLevelHaulJob.Build**: bulk (bridge active + pawn has comp) gathers seed + nearby same-destination stacks (radius 12, cap 16, ~0.8 encumbrance) → AB_BulkHaulAcrossLevels; else single AB_HaulAcrossLevels.
- **JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels**: pick into inventory (SplitOff min(stack, CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered) + Register) → ride stairs (inventory rides despawn) → RequestUnload on arrival level.
- **WorkGiver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels** (bridge-gated) + single giver stands down for comp pawns. Robots/mechs (no comp) keep single carry.
- **Allow Tool** (ABAllowToolCompat, HaulUrgentlyDesignation by name): WorkGiver_ABHaulUrgentlyAcrossLevels (Hauling, prio 100) carries urgent stacks whose storage is cross-level first (bulk when bridge active). Designation clears via Allow Tool's own PlaceHauledThing patch.
- Tested PUAH and HD separately (both "all tests good").

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. Full P1+P2 parity batch built (trade beacons, refuel/vat demand, transporters, surgery ingredients, mech recharge/repair, gear probes, gatherings, childcare). Camera level lock hard. Forced cross-level refuel + Robots++ crossing verified.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; View tab now includes below item-count overlays; jobs tab presets + cadence sliders.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified; probe-gated + StationElsewhere). **Hauler's Dream + Pick Up And Haul (bulk inventory hauling spans levels; single-carry fallback; user-verified). Allow Tool priority hauling (urgent stacks cross first).** Achtung! drags. Reverse Commands (column colonists, self-heal). Giddy-up / Vehicle Framework (routing exclusions). Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (UI, fail-open). All inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: see-below UI upgraded (double-click select-all-of-type + item-count/quality overlays, toggleable) on top of user-verified PUAH/HD bulk hauling + Allow Tool urgent hauling. Compile green — needs a launch to verify double-click multi-select + overlay rendering on the below view. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
